title: In-the-loop Hyper-Parameter Optimization for LLM-Based Automated Design of Heuristics

live_model.evidence: Sec 4.1: "Both frameworks use the gpt-4o-2024-05-13 LLM"; Table 2 TSP100 row LLaMEA-HPO-3 Gap 0.043% (gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 used only by the vanilla-LLaMEA baseline, Sec 4.2).

prompt.location: Appendix A (full initial task prompt per benchmark: Online Bin Packing, BBOB, TSP); Sec 3 (feedback-prompt template structure)
prompt.note: Initial generation prompt is printed in full; each iteration's feedback prompt is built from the live execution/fitness results of LLM-generated code, so only its template (not the many realized instances) is shown.

claim.metric: TSP100 average gap vs. optimal (%), LLaMEA-HPO
claim.location: Table 2, row LLaMEA-HPO-3, TSP100 Gap column (1000 instances per problem size); Table 1 and Figures 2-3 give the BBOB/bin-packing convergence numbers

data.source: BBOB suite and TSPLib are public; bin-packing and TSP20/50/100 test instances are synthetically generated by a described (not fixed-seed) procedure; prompts and code released on Zenodo [Anonymous 2024]

notes: This is an autonomous LLM code-generation/evolutionary-search loop (LLaMEA-HPO vs. EoH vs. vanilla-LLaMEA), not a single-prompt benchmark: reported scores are the end state of 20-2000 sequential LLM calls per run, each requiring the harness to actually execute LLM-generated Python heuristics against domain solvers (IOHexperimenter for BBOB, Concorde for TSP, a custom bin-packing simulator) to build the next feedback prompt. Reproducing the claimed numbers needs this execution infrastructure, not just the printed prompts, so there is no single call-in/number-out pair usable at prompt level.
